summary.en: Light and dark come from one attribute: `data-theme="light|dark|system"` on `<html>` or any subtree. Components read only tokens, so they switch by themselves; you never write dark-mode CSS for a component.
summary.id: Terang dan gelap berasal dari satu atribut: `data-theme="light|dark|system"` pada `<html>` atau subtree mana pun. Komponen hanya membaca token, jadi mereka berganti sendiri; Anda tidak pernah menulis CSS dark mode untuk sebuah komponen.

en.title: Appearance switch
en.desc: A segmented control whose buttons carry `data-lds-theme`. It switches this whole page and remembers the choice in `localStorage`.

en.title: Scoped theme
en.desc: The same card in a light and a dark subtree, side by side on one page. Nothing in the card knows which theme it is in.

Micro business permitOpen

en.title: Page setup without a flash
en.desc: Read the saved choice before the body paints. `restoreTheme()` sets the attribute and returns the mode, so you can sync the switch.
en.html:
<html lang="en" class="lds" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/lds.css">
  <script type="module">
    import { init, restoreTheme } from './js/lds.js';
    const mode = restoreTheme(document.documentElement, 'light');
    init();
  </script>
</head>
en.code:
<html lang="en" class="lds" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/lds.css">
  <script type="module">
    import { init, restoreTheme } from './js/lds.js';
    const mode = restoreTheme(document.documentElement, 'light');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-lds-theme]').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.getAttribute('data-lds-theme') === mode)));
    init();
  </script>
</head>

id.title: Pengalih tampilan
id.desc: Segmented control yang tombolnya membawa `data-lds-theme`. Ia mengganti seluruh halaman ini dan mengingat pilihannya di `localStorage`.

id.title: Tema terbatas
id.desc: Kartu yang sama di subtree terang dan gelap, berdampingan di satu halaman. Tidak ada bagian kartu yang tahu sedang di tema apa.

id.title: Penyiapan halaman tanpa kedipan
id.desc: Baca pilihan yang tersimpan sebelum body digambar. `restoreTheme()` menyetel atribut dan mengembalikan mode, sehingga Anda bisa menyelaraskan pengalihnya.
id.html:

<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/lds.css">
  <script type="module">
    import { init, restoreTheme } from './js/lds.js';
    const mode = restoreTheme(document.documentElement, 'light');
    init();
  </script>
</head>
